Job Description Job Title: IT Network Manager - NY/NJ Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented IT Network Manager to oversee and optimize our organization's network infrastructure and IT systems. This role is ideal for a seasoned IT professional with a strong background in networking, cloud technologies, and IT operations, who is eager to lead, innovate, and ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of our systems. As an IT Network Manager, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining a modern IT environment, including Cisco Meraki infrastructure , Windows 11 devices, Dell hardware, Microsoft 365 services, , and cloud security tools. You will also provide Tier 2 help desk support, manage IT documentation, and lead initiatives to improve user experience and system performance. The ideal candidate will demonstrate leadership, technical expertise, and a commitment to delivering high-quality service while fostering collaboration and growth within the team. Key Responsibilities Network Management (Meraki): Oversee and maintain Cisco Meraki infrastructure, including MX appliances, switches, wireless access points (WAPs), and cameras. Design and implement scalable network solutions to meet business needs, including MX HA/SD-WAN design, VLAN/RF standards, org templates, change control, and SIEM integration. Manage remote access solutions and network security tools (e.g., Cisco Umbrella). Monitor and optimize network performance using tools like Azure Sentinel and SIEM platforms. Endpoint & Identity Management (Intune/Entra ID/GPO): Manage Windows 11 environments, including deployment and configuration using AutoPilot. Administer Dell hardware, ensuring proper setup, maintenance, and lifecycle management. Oversee Microsoft 365 services, including Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, SharePoint, Teams, and Exchange Online. Implement compliance profiles, update rings, app deployment, Conditional Access, RBAC via Security Groups, and GPO baselines with a roadmap to MDM. Remote Monitoring & Management (NinjaOne): Establish patch baselines, scripted remediations, software deployment, remote tools, and telemetry integration with ticketing systems. IT Operations Governance: Develop and maintain DR/BCP runbooks, major-incident playbooks, patch windows, and vendor/SOW ownership (Meraki, Microsoft, NinjaOne, Global Relay). Utilize NinjaOne Ticketing or similar ticketing systems to manage and resolve support requests efficiently. Maintain IT documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), knowledge base articles, and asset tracking records. Promote security best practices across all systems and endpoints. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver user training and improve communication and collaboration tools. Leadership and Innovation: Provide mentorship and guidance to junior IT staff, fostering professional growth and development. Evaluate and implement new technologies, including Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), to enhance IT operations. Drive initiatives to improve user experience, system reliability, and overall IT efficiency. Qualifications Required: 10-15 years of experience in IT network administration or management. Strong knowledge of Cisco Meraki, Windows 11, AutoPilot, and Dell hardware. Expertise in Microsoft 365 services, including Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, SharePoint, Teams, and Exchange Online. Proficiency with Cisco Meraki systems (MX appliances, switches, WAPs, cameras). Experience with cloud security tools such as Azure Sentinel, SIEM platforms, and Cisco Umbrella. Proven experience providing Tier 2 help desk support and troubleshooting. Strong organizational skills with experience in IT documentation, SOP creation, and asset tracking. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to deliver user training and support. Hands-on experience with Intune/Entra ID, GPO baselines, NinjaOne, ABM, Global Relay, and HRIS integrations (Workforce Now/Workday). Preferred Relevant certifications (e.g., Cisco CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft MS-900, or equivalent). Experience with Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) or Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). Knowledge of ITIL practices and IT service management tools. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Attributes We Value Initiative: Proactive and willing to take ownership of tasks and challenges. Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, adapt, and develop technical and leadership skills. Ownership: Takes responsibility for the network infrastructure and IT operations, ensuring reliability and security. Collaboration: Works effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to achieve shared goals. Why Join Us? This is an exciting opportunity to lead and shape the future of our IT network and systems in a dynamic, cloud-first environment. You’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with talented professionals, and have the chance to make a meaningful impact on the organization’s success. Security Clearance Requirement None This position is part of our Critical Infrastructure team. For more than 80 years, our experts have designed and delivered the critical infrastructure that connects and protects communities around the world. We work in collaborative teams, both within the company and with our partners and customers, to plan, design, build, and modernize infrastructure. We take special pride in projects and solutions that improve communities as well as people’s quality of life by promoting economic growth, enhancing mobility, and increasing sustainability and resiliency. Powered by our people, we provide the imagination necessary to support our customers’ visions—and to help them see what's next! Salary Range: $125,100.00 - $225,200.00 We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle! review_candidates.description: Product Manager The Product Manager is responsible for contributing to the evolution of a connectivity product portfolio and progressively owning and scaling value-added service products that extend and differentiate core connectivity offerings. The role sits within the Product Management organization and works closely with Connectivity Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, Operations, and ecosystem partners. Initially, the role will focus on Point of Interconnect (PoI) and Internet connectivity products, building deep familiarity with the service stack before expanding ownership into higher-layer value-added services such as cloud interconnect, SD-WAN, and security overlays. This role requires strong technical depth, a product mindset, and the ability to translate customer and market needs into scalable, commercially viable services. Key Responsibilities Connectivity Portfolio Contribution Contribute to the definition and evolution of connectivity products, including Layer 2 and Internet services, in partnership with existing Connectivity Product Managers. Support alignment of connectivity product requirements with Point of Interconnect capabilities. Ensure connectivity products are defined with a clear path to extensibility through value-added services. Participate in roadmap planning, program-of-record activities, and cross-functional reviews related to connectivity services. Point of Interconnect Product Responsibility Own product requirements for public and private Point of Interconnect options, including interconnectivity with public cloud providers, data centers, and internet exchanges. Contribute to the evolution of PoI-anchored service models that support enterprise, service-provider, and partner use cases. Work with Engineering and Operations to ensure PoI-based offerings are operationally scalable and fulfillment-ready. Engage with external ecosystem partners, including cloud providers, colocation operators, internet exchanges, and terrestrial carriers, to support interoperable and commercially viable interconnect solutions. Value-Added Services Product Ownership Own end-to-end product definition for assigned value-added services, from concept and business case through launch and in-life evolution. Lead product requirements for higher-layer services, including IP services, VPNs, segmentation, traffic engineering, QoS, resiliency, cloud connectivity, and security overlays. Define services that integrate cleanly with enterprise WANs, SD-WAN platforms, and cloud networking constructs, enabling hybrid network architectures. Shape and maintain the roadmap for value-added services, ensuring alignment with connectivity capabilities and commercial priorities. Cross-Functional Leadership and Enablement Act as a product subject-matter expert for Sales, Solution Architecture, and customer engagement teams. Support complex enterprise opportunities by contributing to solution design, service descriptions, and commercial constructs. Collaborate with Engineering and Operations to ensure product intent is reflected in implementation, automation, and operational processes. Commercial and Market Insight Contribute to pricing strategy, service schedules, and SLA frameworks. Incorporate customer feedback, market trends, and competitive intelligence to refine product positioning. Ensure offerings meet enterprise expectations for reliability, security, and global scalability. Required Professional Experience 8+ years of experience in product management, solutions architecture, network engineering, or technical commercial roles within telecom, networking, cloud, or managed services. Demonstrated experience working with enterprise connectivity, interconnect, or cloud-based networking services. Proven ability to operate across technical, commercial, and operational domains. Technical Expertise Strong foundation in IP networking and Layer 3+ services, including routing, VPNs, traffic management, and SD-WAN overlays. Strong foundation in Carrier Ethernet services, including MEF-based service models, service attributes, and operational considerations. Experience with ground interconnect, including Point of Interconnect, data centers, internet exchanges, cloud connectivity, and terrestrial backhaul. Familiarity with enterprise cloud networking and hybrid connectivity models. Product and Commercial Skills Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, customer-centric product offerings. Experience defining service constructs, SLAs, and commercial frameworks. Strong written and verbal communication skills. ,

review_candidates.title: Tavolata Manager
review_candidates.description: Chi siamo Tavolata è uno studio culinario creativo con base a Milano, attivo in tutta Italia e a livello internazionale. Creiamo eventi ed esperienze su misura in cui gastronomia, design, atmosfera e ospitalità si incontrano. Da cene intime e celebrazioni private a matrimoni ed eventi di più ampia scala, ogni progetto Tavolata nasce da una particolare attenzione ai dettagli, all’estetica e all’esperienza degli ospiti. Il nostro lavoro unisce produzione di eventi, ricerca culinaria, location scouting, styling, mise en place, elementi floreali e collaborazioni con chef, artigiani, location e partner creativi. Descrizione del ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Event & Hospitality Manager che entri a far parte di Tavolata. La posizione prevede principalmente lavoro da remoto, ma è indispensabile che la persona viva a Milano e sia disponibile per meeting in presenza, sopralluoghi ed eventi quando necessario. Milano rappresenta la nostra principale base operativa, ma Tavolata lavora in tutta Italia e a livello internazionale. La persona dovrà quindi essere disponibile a viaggiare in Italia e all’estero in base ai progetti e agli eventi in programma. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature di persone che non vivono attualmente a Milano. Cerchiamo una figura operativa con una solida e comprovata esperienza nel settore degli eventi e dell’ospitalità. Non siamo interessati a profili provenienti esclusivamente da settori affini, come project management, product design o altre industrie, che non abbiano maturato un’esperienza diretta nell’organizzazione di eventi e nel mondo dell’hospitality. La persona ideale conosce tutte le fasi necessarie per gestire un evento, dalla prima richiesta del cliente fino alla sua realizzazione, mantenendo sempre il livello di cura, gusto e attenzione ai dettagli che caratterizza Tavolata. Responsabilità Il ruolo comprende: * Gestione delle guest relations prima, durante e dopo gli eventi. * Gestione delle email, delle richieste dei clienti e delle nuove richieste relative agli eventi. * Gestione della relazione con il cliente durante tutte le fasi di organizzazione. * Organizzazione e coordinamento degli eventi dalla richiesta iniziale fino alla loro realizzazione. * Sopralluoghi e site inspection quando necessario. * Location scouting a Milano, in Italia e all’estero. * Coordinamento di location, fornitori, chef, partner e professionisti coinvolti nei diversi progetti. * Gestione della logistica, delle tempistiche e degli aspetti operativi degli eventi. * Presenza on-site quando richiesta e supervisione del corretto svolgimento dell’evento. * Supporto alla parte creativa ed estetica dell’evento, con particolare attenzione all’allestimento, alla mise en place e all’atmosfera generale. * Capacità di comprendere l’estetica Tavolata e assicurarsi che ogni evento sia coerente con l’identità e gli standard del brand. * Gestione contemporanea di più progetti e richieste, mantenendo precisione, reattività e attenzione ai dettagli. Requisiti È richiesta un’esperienza professionale di almeno 2 anni nel settore degli eventi e/o dell’hospitality, con esperienza diretta nell’organizzazione e nella realizzazione di eventi. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature prive di precedente esperienza professionale nel settore degli eventi o dell’ospitalità. Esperienze esclusivamente nel product design, nel project management generico o in altri settori affini non sono sufficienti per questa posizione. La persona ideale dovrà avere: * Almeno 2 anni di esperienza comprovata nel settore eventi e/o hospitality. * Residenza attuale a Milano. * Disponibilità per meeting, sopralluoghi ed eventi in presenza a Milano. * Disponibilità a viaggiare in tutta Italia e all’estero quando richiesto. * Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. * Ottime capacità nella gestione degli ospiti e delle relazioni con i clienti. * Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e autonomia nella gestione delle richieste relative agli eventi. * Comprovate capacità organizzative e capacità di seguire un evento dalla fase di pianificazione fino alla realizzazione. * Esperienza nella gestione e nel coordinamento di location, fornitori e partner esterni. * Capacità di effettuare sopralluoghi e valutare potenziali location per gli eventi. * Grande attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di anticipare esigenze operative ed eventuali criticità. * Forte sensibilità verso il mondo dell’ospitalità e comprensione di ciò che rende un’esperienza accogliente, personale e memorabile. * Spiccato senso estetico e buon gusto, in particolare per quanto riguarda allestimenti, mise en place, spazi e atmosfera. * Attitudine proattiva, flessibile e operativa. * Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, mantenendo allo stesso tempo un confronto costante con il team Tavolata

review_candidates.title: Driftsplanlegger
review_candidates.description: Planavdelingen i Sporveien T-banen består i dag av 6 dyktige ansatte. Som følge av økt arbeidsmengde søker vi nå en driftsplanlegger til. Avdelingens viktigste arbeidsoppgaver er å skape vognplaner, optimere tjenesteplaner og lage effektive turnuser med utgangspunkt i bedriftens avtaleverk og praktiseringer. Arbeidssted vil være på Tøyen - med muligheter for hjemmekontor. Arbeidsoppgaver Utvikle vognplaner, samt optimere tjenesteplaner og turnus med fokus på kosteffektivitet Vedlikehold og utvikling av plan- og optimeringsverktøy Simulere og analysere alternativer som skal danne beslutningsunderlag Sikre riktig ressursutnyttelse ut ifra produksjon og tariffavtale. Bidra til forbedrings- og kvalitetsarbeid innen eget ansvarsområde, samt initiere forbedringer innenfor T-banen generelt Delta i prosjekter innenfor egne fagområder Ønskede Kvalifikasjoner Høyere utdanning innen relevant fagområde. Manglende formell utdannelse kan kompenseres med relevant bransjeerfaring. Gode IT-kunnskaper og forståelse for oppbygging av planleggings- og driftssystemer. Erfaring fra HASTUS eller andre plan-/optimeringssystemer er en fordel. Erfaring fra rute- og driftsplanlegging, optimering med IT-verktøy eller annet beslektet fagområde (trafikkplanlegging) Norsk er arbeidsspråk og må beherskes godt muntlig og skriftlig. I tillegg er det viktig med gode engelskkunnskaper Personlige Egenskaper/ferdigheter Du jobber målrettet, er løsningsorientert og evner å se behov for forbedringer innenfor eget fagområde og avdeling Du har øye for detaljer og er nøyaktig, strukturert og analytisk. Du setter deg hurtig inn i nye oppgaver og problemstillinger Du er positiv, initiativrik og fleksibel. Du evner å argumentere for eget arbeid og forankre dette samt gjennomføre det som besluttes. Du er selvstendig, men trives også med å jobbe i team – gode samarbeidsevner er en selvfølge. Du overholder frister og følger avtaleverk. Hvorfor Sporveien I Sporveien står helse, miljø og sikkerhet alltid i fokus. Vi skal unngå skader til en hver tid og våre ansatte skal være trygge på jobben. Du blir en viktig del av et av landets største transportør av persontrafikk som er en samfunnsviktig arbeidsgiver med stor betydning for miljøet, bylivet og kollektivtrafikken. Vi ønsker å tilrettelegge for et grønnere samfunn, og jobber for å levere mest mulig kollektivtrafikk for pengene slik at flest mulig lar bilen stå, og heller reiser kollektivt. Uavhengig om du er leder eller medarbeider kan vi tilby varierte, spennende og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver. I Sporveien er det kort avstand til et mangfold av fagmiljøer. Vi holder til i moderne lokaler på Tøyen samt på flere baser/verksteder sentralt beliggende i/rundt Oslo. Vi har et sterkt og godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dedikerte kollegaer som også er opptatt av å være sosiale gjennom ulike aktiviteter. Blant våre ansattgoder finner du et mangfold av aktiviteter og tilbud, subsidiert kantine og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Som ansatt i Sporveien vil du få personalbillett på Ruter sitt rutenett i Oslo og Akershus. Våre verdier ligger til grunn for våre prioriteringer, strategiske valg og i det daglige arbeidet vi gjør. For at du skal trives hos oss vil du kjenne deg igjen i våre verdier - Pålitelig, Engasjert og Samhandlende. Sporveien samarbeider med Semac om bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle finale kandidater. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV i forbindelse med ansettelsen. Sporveien er underlagt offentlighetsloven som betyr at offentlige søkerlister kan bli utarbeidet ( 25). Høres dette spennende ut? Søk via vårt rekrutteringssystem med søknad og CV. Søknadsfrist er 10. Sep 2026.

review_candidates.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
review_candidates.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem. Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About The Role We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering . Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it. You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter. This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace. The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV. What You'll Do Own the strategy and the stack Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together. Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself. Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams. Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback. Build, hands-on Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production. Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails. Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely. Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript. Automate across SDR, AE, and AM Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution. Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds. Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning. Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales. Bridge commercial and technical Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises. Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently. Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership. Build the team Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America. Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely. Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure. Experience What Will Make You Successful Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both. Technical craft Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on. Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are. Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required. Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run. Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly. Commercial instinct You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped. You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer. You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath. Nice to have Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR. Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy. Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America. Why This Role GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast. You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible. If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

review_candidates.title: Account Executive - BNLX (Belgium market)
review_candidates.description: Who we are At OpenUp, our mission is to make mental well-being accessible to everyone. Following a 'high tech & high touch' approach, we support companies, their employees, and their families with proactive and practical mental health services. Through our digital platform, clients can access 1:1 check-ins, online courses, articles, videos, group sessions, mindfulness practices, and a team of committed mental well-being experts. As we believe that mental and physical well-being are deeply connected, we have also added Lifestyle Experts to our offering, focusing on nutrition, exercise, and sleep. We offer a truly holistic approach that helps people take ownership of their health. We're proud to work with forward-thinking organizations and are committed to raising the bar on accessible care. OpenUp was ranked in the Top 3 on LinkedIn's Top Startups list for 2023, 2024 & 2025 and is continuously growing. We are already serving 2000+ companies (e.g. Rituals, Deloitte, Decathlon, KPMG, and McDonald's), through which 600K+ employees have access to our product. Now, we're setting our sights on Belgium and we're looking for the person who will help us build it. Your job This is a founding role. As our Founding Account Executive for BNLX , you will be selling and shaping how OpenUp shows up in the Belgian market. You'll own the medium enterprise segment end to end and play a defining role in our expansion in the region. You are responsible for the sales process from A to Z: exploring the market, building pipeline, planning and running sales conversations, and negotiating contracts to close. Because you're early, you'll have real influence over strategy, positioning, and how we win, and you'll work closely with our Business Development, Customer Success, Marketing, and leadership teams to make it happen. You won't be doing this alone. You'll be part of our European sales team, and you can count on their full support and close collaboration as you build Belgium from the ground up. Next to that: You put OpenUp on the map in Belgium and build our network of B2B partnerships from the ground up. You acquire new medium enterprise clients and create opportunities within existing accounts. You are the face and first point of contact for customers in your market. You bring the voice of the Belgian market back to the team, helping us adapt and grow smartly. About You OpenUp loves people. We hope you do too. Engaging with people from all walks of life is something you genuinely enjoy. You thrive in a team, communicate effectively at every level, and you're excited about mental health — a topic that should be as normal as going to the gym. You'd love to connect to this higher purpose. Above all, you're entrepreneurial. You see the blank canvas of a new market as an opportunity, not a risk. You're a self-starter who takes ownership, learns fast, gets back up after setbacks — and celebrates the wins. A courageous mission needs great people. Ready to build with us? You're from Belgium and know the market from the inside. You're based in (or happy to be based in) Belgium(Remote) or Amsterdam(Hybrid). Approaching people comes naturally to you. You're a real networker with, or the ability to build, a strong network, ideally within HR. You have at least 4 years of sales experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, HR platforms, or a high-growth startup/scale-up environment. Pipedrive, HubSpot, or Salesforce are well-known names to you. You have an academic working and thinking level and you are action-oriented. You thrive in a fast-paced, build-it-yourself environment and are a great team player. You are fluent in Dutch and French and speak great English. new_matches.title: Technisch Manager
new_matches.description: Mission Heb jij een passie voor vastgoed en techniek? Heb je ervaring opgedaan bij een vastgoedbeheerder, belegger, aannemer of projectontwikkelaar? En vind je het uitdagend om technische vraagstukken te combineren met de commerciële belangen van vastgoedeigenaren en gebruikers? Dan komen wij graag met jou in contact. Esset is een toonaangevende vastgoedorganisatie gespecialiseerd in property management. Vanuit onze kantoren in Nederland, België en Luxemburg beheren wij een omvangrijke en diverse portefeuille van kantoren, logistiek vastgoed en retailobjecten voor nationale en internationale beleggers. Ter uitbreiding van onze portefeuille zijn wij op zoek naar een Technisch Manager die wil bijdragen aan het optimaal functioneren, verduurzamen en toekomstbestendig maken van vastgoed. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Als Technisch Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het technisch beheer van een groeiende portefeuille van kantoren, retail- en logistieke objecten. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen commercieel, financieel en technisch beheer en bent het technisch aanspreekpunt voor vastgoedeigenaren, huurders en leveranciers. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de vastgoedportefeuille technisch optimaal presteert en aansluit op de doelstellingen van onze opdrachtgevers. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Opstellen en beheren van MJOP's, onderhoudsbegrotingen en technische managementrapportages; Aanbesteden, coördineren en aansturen van onderhouds- en vervangingsprojecten; Afsluiten, beheren en monitoren van onderhouds- en servicecontracten; Bewaken van kwaliteit, planning en budgetten; Toezien op onderhoudsverplichtingen van huurders; Adviseren van opdrachtgevers over technische vraagstukken en investeringsbeslissingen; Signaleren en initiëren van verduurzamingsmaatregelen; Vertalen van ESG-doelstellingen naar concrete projecten en verbeteringen; Onderhouden van contacten met huurders, leveranciers, adviseurs en overheidsinstanties. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een professioneel team van specialisten en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Head of The Netherlands. Profil Jouw profiel Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in bouwkunde, vastgoed of een vergelijkbare technische richting; Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen vastgoedbeheer, projectontwikkeling, bouw of technische dienstverlening; Kennis van zowel bouwkundige als installatietechnische systemen; Ervaring met onderhoudsplanningen, budgetten en technische projecten; Affiniteit met duurzaamheid en energietransitie; Commercieel inzicht en gevoel voor klantbelangen; Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Ervaring met Yardi is een pré. Wat wij bieden Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationaal opererende vastgoedorganisatie; Een zelfstandige rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid en direct klantcontact; Werken voor toonaangevende nationale en internationale beleggers; Ruimte voor opleiding, ontwikkeling en doorgroei; Een professioneel team met ervaren vastgoedspecialisten; Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden; Leaseauto, laptop en telefoon; Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en hybride werken; Een informele en ondernemende werksfeer waarin initiatief wordt gewaardeerd.

new_matches.title: Tavolata Manager
new_matches.description: Chi siamo Tavolata è uno studio culinario creativo con base a Milano, attivo in tutta Italia e a livello internazionale. Creiamo eventi ed esperienze su misura in cui gastronomia, design, atmosfera e ospitalità si incontrano. Da cene intime e celebrazioni private a matrimoni ed eventi di più ampia scala, ogni progetto Tavolata nasce da una particolare attenzione ai dettagli, all’estetica e all’esperienza degli ospiti. Il nostro lavoro unisce produzione di eventi, ricerca culinaria, location scouting, styling, mise en place, elementi floreali e collaborazioni con chef, artigiani, location e partner creativi. Descrizione del ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Event & Hospitality Manager che entri a far parte di Tavolata. La posizione prevede principalmente lavoro da remoto, ma è indispensabile che la persona viva a Milano e sia disponibile per meeting in presenza, sopralluoghi ed eventi quando necessario. Milano rappresenta la nostra principale base operativa, ma Tavolata lavora in tutta Italia e a livello internazionale. La persona dovrà quindi essere disponibile a viaggiare in Italia e all’estero in base ai progetti e agli eventi in programma. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature di persone che non vivono attualmente a Milano. Cerchiamo una figura operativa con una solida e comprovata esperienza nel settore degli eventi e dell’ospitalità. Non siamo interessati a profili provenienti esclusivamente da settori affini, come project management, product design o altre industrie, che non abbiano maturato un’esperienza diretta nell’organizzazione di eventi e nel mondo dell’hospitality. La persona ideale conosce tutte le fasi necessarie per gestire un evento, dalla prima richiesta del cliente fino alla sua realizzazione, mantenendo sempre il livello di cura, gusto e attenzione ai dettagli che caratterizza Tavolata. Responsabilità Il ruolo comprende: * Gestione delle guest relations prima, durante e dopo gli eventi. * Gestione delle email, delle richieste dei clienti e delle nuove richieste relative agli eventi. * Gestione della relazione con il cliente durante tutte le fasi di organizzazione. * Organizzazione e coordinamento degli eventi dalla richiesta iniziale fino alla loro realizzazione. * Sopralluoghi e site inspection quando necessario. * Location scouting a Milano, in Italia e all’estero. * Coordinamento di location, fornitori, chef, partner e professionisti coinvolti nei diversi progetti. * Gestione della logistica, delle tempistiche e degli aspetti operativi degli eventi. * Presenza on-site quando richiesta e supervisione del corretto svolgimento dell’evento. * Supporto alla parte creativa ed estetica dell’evento, con particolare attenzione all’allestimento, alla mise en place e all’atmosfera generale. * Capacità di comprendere l’estetica Tavolata e assicurarsi che ogni evento sia coerente con l’identità e gli standard del brand. * Gestione contemporanea di più progetti e richieste, mantenendo precisione, reattività e attenzione ai dettagli. Requisiti È richiesta un’esperienza professionale di almeno 2 anni nel settore degli eventi e/o dell’hospitality, con esperienza diretta nell’organizzazione e nella realizzazione di eventi. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature prive di precedente esperienza professionale nel settore degli eventi o dell’ospitalità. Esperienze esclusivamente nel product design, nel project management generico o in altri settori affini non sono sufficienti per questa posizione. La persona ideale dovrà avere: * Almeno 2 anni di esperienza comprovata nel settore eventi e/o hospitality. * Residenza attuale a Milano. * Disponibilità per meeting, sopralluoghi ed eventi in presenza a Milano. * Disponibilità a viaggiare in tutta Italia e all’estero quando richiesto. * Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. * Ottime capacità nella gestione degli ospiti e delle relazioni con i clienti. * Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e autonomia nella gestione delle richieste relative agli eventi. * Comprovate capacità organizzative e capacità di seguire un evento dalla fase di pianificazione fino alla realizzazione. * Esperienza nella gestione e nel coordinamento di location, fornitori e partner esterni. * Capacità di effettuare sopralluoghi e valutare potenziali location per gli eventi. * Grande attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di anticipare esigenze operative ed eventuali criticità. * Forte sensibilità verso il mondo dell’ospitalità e comprensione di ciò che rende un’esperienza accogliente, personale e memorabile. * Spiccato senso estetico e buon gusto, in particolare per quanto riguarda allestimenti, mise en place, spazi e atmosfera. * Attitudine proattiva, flessibile e operativa. * Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, mantenendo allo stesso tempo un confronto costante con il team Tavolata

new_matches.description: Job Description / Essential Elements GATEWAY UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT JOB DESCRIPTION: RESOURCE SPECIALIST TEACHER Definition 100% time Resource Specialist Teacher. Directly Responsible To Site Administrator or Designee and Director of Special Education. Immediate Subordinates Any assigned Classified Staff. Essential Functions Participates regularly on the School Assessment Team which reviews and monitors the progress of referred students in order to meet their individual needs. Participates in the formal student assessment process for Special Education eligibility, review and placement. Participates with the Psychologist, School Principal, and appropriate District professional staff (along with the parents) in the development and implementation of the Individual Education Plan for each formally identified student. Evaluates (on an ongoing basis) the needs of assigned pupils in order to design and implement an instructional program based upon the needs. Provides specialized instructional activities which establish, maintain and reinforce appropriate interpersonal and learning behaviors. Maintains a variety of pupil records; anecdotal records for each pupil which outlines their educational problems; and the solution plan including basic learning steps. Creates a functional and attractive room environment for learning through displays, bulletin boards and interest centers. Regularly communicates with regular classroom teachers regarding students in the Resources Specialist Program. Participates in curriculum and other developmental programs within the school of assignment and/or on the district level. Administers group standardized tests in accordance with District Programs. Supervises pupils in out-of-classroom activities during the assigned working day. Participates in curriculum and other developmental programs. Participates with other professional staff members in the school’s extra-curricular activities. Serves as a member of the School Site Assessment Team for the admission, placement and evaluation of pupils in the Chapter I and Alternative Learning Center Programs. Shares in the sponsorship of pupil activities and participation in faculty committees. Participates in district sponsored school activities and events including but not limited to Back to School Night, Open House, Home School Club events, etc. Performs other duties as assigned. new_matches.title: Driftsplanlegger
new_matches.description: Planavdelingen i Sporveien T-banen består i dag av 6 dyktige ansatte. Som følge av økt arbeidsmengde søker vi nå en driftsplanlegger til. Avdelingens viktigste arbeidsoppgaver er å skape vognplaner, optimere tjenesteplaner og lage effektive turnuser med utgangspunkt i bedriftens avtaleverk og praktiseringer. Arbeidssted vil være på Tøyen - med muligheter for hjemmekontor. Arbeidsoppgaver Utvikle vognplaner, samt optimere tjenesteplaner og turnus med fokus på kosteffektivitet Vedlikehold og utvikling av plan- og optimeringsverktøy Simulere og analysere alternativer som skal danne beslutningsunderlag Sikre riktig ressursutnyttelse ut ifra produksjon og tariffavtale. Bidra til forbedrings- og kvalitetsarbeid innen eget ansvarsområde, samt initiere forbedringer innenfor T-banen generelt Delta i prosjekter innenfor egne fagområder Ønskede Kvalifikasjoner Høyere utdanning innen relevant fagområde. Manglende formell utdannelse kan kompenseres med relevant bransjeerfaring. Gode IT-kunnskaper og forståelse for oppbygging av planleggings- og driftssystemer. Erfaring fra HASTUS eller andre plan-/optimeringssystemer er en fordel. Erfaring fra rute- og driftsplanlegging, optimering med IT-verktøy eller annet beslektet fagområde (trafikkplanlegging) Norsk er arbeidsspråk og må beherskes godt muntlig og skriftlig. I tillegg er det viktig med gode engelskkunnskaper Personlige Egenskaper/ferdigheter Du jobber målrettet, er løsningsorientert og evner å se behov for forbedringer innenfor eget fagområde og avdeling Du har øye for detaljer og er nøyaktig, strukturert og analytisk. Du setter deg hurtig inn i nye oppgaver og problemstillinger Du er positiv, initiativrik og fleksibel. Du evner å argumentere for eget arbeid og forankre dette samt gjennomføre det som besluttes. Du er selvstendig, men trives også med å jobbe i team – gode samarbeidsevner er en selvfølge. Du overholder frister og følger avtaleverk. Hvorfor Sporveien I Sporveien står helse, miljø og sikkerhet alltid i fokus. Vi skal unngå skader til en hver tid og våre ansatte skal være trygge på jobben. Du blir en viktig del av et av landets største transportør av persontrafikk som er en samfunnsviktig arbeidsgiver med stor betydning for miljøet, bylivet og kollektivtrafikken. Vi ønsker å tilrettelegge for et grønnere samfunn, og jobber for å levere mest mulig kollektivtrafikk for pengene slik at flest mulig lar bilen stå, og heller reiser kollektivt. Uavhengig om du er leder eller medarbeider kan vi tilby varierte, spennende og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver. I Sporveien er det kort avstand til et mangfold av fagmiljøer. Vi holder til i moderne lokaler på Tøyen samt på flere baser/verksteder sentralt beliggende i/rundt Oslo. Vi har et sterkt og godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dedikerte kollegaer som også er opptatt av å være sosiale gjennom ulike aktiviteter. Blant våre ansattgoder finner du et mangfold av aktiviteter og tilbud, subsidiert kantine og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Som ansatt i Sporveien vil du få personalbillett på Ruter sitt rutenett i Oslo og Akershus. Våre verdier ligger til grunn for våre prioriteringer, strategiske valg og i det daglige arbeidet vi gjør. For at du skal trives hos oss vil du kjenne deg igjen i våre verdier - Pålitelig, Engasjert og Samhandlende. Sporveien samarbeider med Semac om bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle finale kandidater. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals. What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent Your Responsibilities Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down. Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy. Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it. Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently. Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale. The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team. A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job. Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments. Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment. Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 5,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, Gusto and Auto1, Moss has raised €200+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. Moss is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star and Portage. new_matches.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
new_matches.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem. Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About The Role We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering . Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it. You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter. This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace. The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV. What You'll Do Own the strategy and the stack Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together. Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself. Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams. Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback. Build, hands-on Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production. Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails. Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely. Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript. Automate across SDR, AE, and AM Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution. Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds. Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning. Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales. Bridge commercial and technical Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises. Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently. Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership. Build the team Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America. Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely. Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure. Experience What Will Make You Successful Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both. Technical craft Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on. Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are. Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required. Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.
